title: Resignation of Vice Chairman X_AgsFang
author: MPSNet
excerpt: Brigadier General X_AgsFang, Vice Chairman of the Military Police School, announced his resignation on November 5, 2026, closing a long and dedicated journey at MPS.

body.text: The Vice Chairman of the Military Police School, Brigadier General X_AgsFang, announced his resignation on November 5, 2026 at 8:44 AM, bringing to a close a long and dedicated journey at MPS.

X_AgsFang shared the news in a resignation notice addressed to the school, stating that he will step down from the position of Vice Chairman sometime this week. Until his official departure, he will remain in office and continue helping the school, and he will send a separate announcement once he has officially left.

The Vice Chairman made clear that the decision was not made overnight. He had been considering it for a while, feeling that he was not being active enough or giving the school what it deserved. He also noted that reaching a high position like HICOM can make it difficult to keep the same motivation, and that he is stepping aside so someone more dedicated can fill the position. He had wanted to resign weeks earlier, and stayed on only because Master convinced him to.
I think it's just how it is; once you get to a higher position like HICOM, you lose motivation to do anything, so I am leaving so someone more dedicated can fill my spot.
body.by: Brigadier General X_AgsFang, Vice Chairman of MPS

body.text: X_AgsFang used the notice to thank everyone he had the opportunity to work alongside. He singled out combatkitty for giving him an opportunity in MPS, and said he appreciated the experiences, opportunities, and friendships he gained along the way.

It's been a pleasure serving alongside you all, contributing to MPS, and watching the div grow. I've made a lot of memories here. But my time has come to resign. I wish MPS the best of luck in the future.
body.by: Brigadier General X_AgsFang, Vice Chairman of MPS

body.text: X_AgsFang joined the Military Police School on May 16, 2026 and served for nearly six months, rising from Senior Instructor to High Command. He became a member of High Command on July 7, 2026, and was promoted to Brigadier General and Vice Chairman on October 6, 2026.

Date | Rank | Position
--- | --- | ---
May 16, 2026 | Captain (O3) | Senior Instructor
May 25, 2026 | Major (O4) | Lead Instructor
June 8, 2026 | Colonel (O6) | Head Instructor
June 15, 2026 | Colonel (O6) | Chief Instructor
July 7, 2026 | Sergeant Major (E9B) | Senior Enlisted Advisor
October 6, 2026 | Brigadier General (O7) | Vice Chairman
No successor has been announced. Under the new rank structure, the position of Vice Chairman is now known as Executive Officer and is currently listed as vacant.
MPSNet thanks Brigadier General X_AgsFang for his service to the Military Police School and wishes him the best in everything that comes next.
